502781.title: Sampha: Process
502781.overview: Process is a striking, avant-garde portrait of Sampha using documentary-style footage to depict his roots in Morden, South London, and Freetown, Sierra Leone.

822653.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
822653.overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

1001405.title: Too Many Beasts
1001405.overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

1002109.title: Police Flash 80
1002109.overview: Paris, 1980s. When his old cop partner is killed in action, Yvon Kastendeuch is propelled to the head of a new unit : Police Flash 80. There, he'll have to team up with young recruits who will challenge his old "dominant male" habits.

1061821.title: Love Is a Gypsy Child: A Carmen Story
1061821.overview: Andalusia, Spain, 1840. After three years of wandering, Salva, who works as an assistant to a blind knife sharpener, returns to Seville, his hometown, where he meets Carmen, a gypsy woman with a captivating voice.

1189885.title: The Morrigan
1189885.overview: Archaeologist Fiona travels to Ireland to uncover a long-dead tomb. A threat is released and she will have to fight to keep her teenage daughter from falling under the control of The Morrigan, a vengeful Pagan War Goddess.
1189885.trailerName: The Morrigan | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1211005.title: Vindicta
1211005.overview: In just one moment 19-year-old Hannah's world shatters when her parents are murdered in front of her. After fleeing, she seeks refuge with family friends before becoming the embodiment of rage and revenge towards those responsible for destroying her life. An unexpected connection with a handsome young Nazi Officer generates a moment of respite, but she is consumed by vengeance at any cost, no matter what or when. The story is inspired by the true events of women who helped defeat the Nazis during WWII.

1228477.title: Chebi: My Fluffy Friend 2
1228477.overview: Cheburashka gradually gets used to life with Gena, but like any growing child, Cheburashka begins to show excessive independence, and sometimes even become a hooligan. They live happily until their peaceful life is disrupted by an incredible event. In the second part, not only the already beloved heroes will remain, but also new, unusual characters will appear.

1239037.title: Deep Quiet Room
1239037.overview: After his pregnant wife Yi-ting unexpectedly committed suicide, Ming decides to take care of his father-in-law, only to find out the unbearable truth of Yi-ting’s family that leads to her death.

1247165.title: Raja Shivaji
1247165.overview: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

1249021.title: A Sunken Place
1249021.overview: A young neurologist discovers a cure for depression, only to be opposed by a giant pharmaceutical corporation determined to destroy her.

1251517.title: Real Faces
1251517.overview: When her relationship abroad falls apart, Julia returns to Belgium. She tries to build a new life for herself in Brussels as a casting director in the advertising industry. Lonely in an unfamiliar city and wrestling with a broken heart, she keeps up appearances and immerses herself in her new job. Her encounter with Eliott makes her realize that she doesn’t know who she really is.

1263037.title: Cheekatilo
1263037.overview: When crime anchor Sandhya’s best friend is found dead under suspicious circumstances, she embarks on a dangerous investigation that collides with a dark past. As secrets unravel, Sandhya must face her trauma and rise as a fearless voice for the silenced.
1263037.trailerName: Cheekatilo - Official Trailer | Sobhita Dhulipala | Prime Video India

1275581.title: He Bled Neon
1275581.overview: After learning his brother’s death may be murder, Ethan returns to Las Vegas to uncover the truth, and confront the violent past he buried. Once a street kid, he’s now living the good life in L.A., engaged to his dream girl and working for her father’s real estate firm. But when he gets a text saying his brother overdosed, the promise he made to never return home shatters, pulling him back into the world he thought he’d escaped.

1287805.title: Night Comes
1287805.overview: Against the backdrop of a cataclysmic event that threatens to engulf humanity, two sisters manage to escape the horror only to find themselves thrust into a perilous struggle for survival, tasked with a mission that holds the fate of mankind in the balance.

1288445.title: Mutiny
1288445.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

1299581.title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
1299581.overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

1303357.title: Silent Rebellion
1303357.overview: 15-year-old Emma, pregnant after a rape, defies her repressive rural Protestant community to carve a path of self-determination, transforming trauma into a catalyst for emancipation while confronting the moral hypocrisy of the village and the spectre of World War II around her.

1354301.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
1354301.overview: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.
1354301.trailerName: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution | Official Trailer

1356797.title: Bonkey: The Mutated
1356797.overview: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.
1356797.trailerName: Bonkey: The Mutated | Official TV Spot | Horror Comedy (2026)

1362365.title: This Is Buzz
1362365.overview: A mind-blowing music documentary about the first immersive TV show on MTV when MTV was cool.
1362365.trailerName: THIS IS BUZZ | Official 4K Trailer (2026) | DOCUMENTARY | Film Threat Trailers

1367933.title: The Second Child
1367933.overview: After three years of coma, Su-an wakes up to find the ghost of her dead sister asking for help but cannot understand what exactly she requires. Their mother, Geum-ok, believed to have lost her firstborn child to suicide, searches for the truth behind the death as a centuries-old family curse slowly reveals itself. As the two collide in a quest to discover the past and present reality, they come across Jae-in, an exact look-alike of the deceased sister.

1397373.title: Cena di classe
1397373.overview: A group of former high school classmates reunite after seventeen years for the funeral of an old friend. Aided by alcohol and a forgotten video, they sneak into their old school one night to relive the magic of that time. But a simple reunion quickly turns into a criminal adventure.

1399741.title: Tethered
1399741.overview: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

1409853.title: Neglected
1409853.overview: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

1425085.title: Mojoku Hilang!
1425085.overview: Adi, a corporate climber at Moo Magic Farms who turns a distinctive cow named Mojo into a viral sensation while pursuing aggressive rural farm acquisitions. His plans take an unexpected turn when he encounters a resistant farming community and its determined inhabitants.
1425085.trailerName: Mojoku Hilang | Official Teaser | Di Pawagam Julai Ini

1430077.title: Hokum
1430077.overview: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

1431677.title: Árru
1431677.overview: Sámi reindeer herder Maia fights to protect her ancestral lands from a looming mining project. Amid the growing protests, she is also confronted with deeply buried family traumas. Maia is forced to make a decision.

1441149.title: Vishnu Vinyasam
1441149.overview: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

1443069.title: 3xHelô
1443069.overview: A girl just broke up with her boyfriend and needs to talk.

1446077.title: Construction Site
1446077.overview: Set within the confines of this exceptional construction site, the film paints a portrait of a miniature society, driven by a common goal: to build cinemas for the next century. From the architect to the journeymen carpenters, from the site manager to the head of the Pathé group, from the designer of the speakers to the future projectionists, the film paints a vivid portrait of this society at a human level.

1446589.title: Wanderer
1446589.overview: WANDERER is a religious action thriller set in an alternate, dystopian future where the United States has been disbanded and divided into eight individual factions. A lone wanderer journeys across these factions, carrying a forbidden item: a Holy Bible. Hunted relentlessly by faction leaders and their military forces, the Wanderer uses the Word of God to spread hope among the oppressed citizens and fight back against the evil forces controlling them.

1447357.title: To Wander the Earth
1447357.overview: Across three pivotal moments in his life, a masochistic ex-Catholic desperately chases penitential fire, struggling to survive his loss of faith.

1470269.title: Human Hibachi 3: The Last Supper
1470269.overview: A man who suffers from hyper-religiosity, leads a cult of devout followers to partake in a "last supper" where sacrificed humans are the main course.

1472573.title: Yura Was Here
1472573.overview: At 30, Oleg and Seryoga still dream of becoming rock stars. They play in a little-known band, live in a communal apartment, and are preparing for an important performance at a local festival. On the eve of the concert, they are unexpectedly approached by Oleg's uncle, a 50-year-old man with mental disabilities, whom the boys cannot leave unattended, not even for a minute.

1472829.title: Molière, Cyrano and the Young King
1472829.overview: During the Paris rebellion, young Louis XIV must be hidden from danger and is secretly replaced at court by a look-alike. Entrusted to the musketeer-poet Cyrano de Bergerac, Louis is sheltered within Madeleine Béjart’s traveling theater troupe, where the actor and aspiring playwright Molière has just joined – unaware their newest member is the future king of France. As Cyrano struggles to handle the arrogant and clumsy young king, he begins writing a bold play for the troupe. Molière, bursting with ideas, transforms the work with wit and heart, awakening his genius for comedy and deepening his secret feelings for Madeleine, while young Louis discovers the joy of theater and the power of friendship. But back in Paris, intrigue is brewing – can the young king return in time before the masquerade is revealed and embrace his true royal destiny?

1476989.title: Beauty
1476989.overview: December 1941. Leningrad. The story centers on the main character, who, together with other employees, saves zoo animals from shelling. The people themselves are on the brink of life and death, but they do not abandon the hippopotamus named Krasavitsa.

1481789.title: Bloody Men
1481789.overview: After yet another furious argument, seven-year-old Andrev's mother lets him in on a secret: his father is, in fact, not his father. Rather than devastated, Andrev is excited by the possibilities this revelation opens up. With a childish resilience, he navigates life and his mother's more or less destructive relationships with various boyfriends. Men are drawn to her like moths to a flame, but she cannot control how they behave. According to the boy, his mother's boyfriends resemble magicians and murderers, artists and thieves, and – just like growing pains – they appear uninvited and leave unexpectedly.

1483325.title: Anna VS the Kids
1483325.overview: Anna, a friendly but reclusive fortysomething, harbors an unusual phobia: she’s terrified of children. When she reconnects with Alexandre, her ex-boyfriend she never stopped loving, she thinks she’s finally found happiness… until she discovers he has two kids. When circumstances force her to care for them alone, a panicked Anna reluctantly agrees. Between ridiculous rules and absurd situations, this forced living arrangement might just change everything… for worse, but also for better.

1495293.title: Arasan
1495293.overview: Taking place as an untold story in the same world as Vetrimaaran's Vadachennai, a man holds a struggling, dark past in the 1990s.

1510333.title: Hair, Paper, Water...

1510333.trailerName: Hair, Paper, Water (Nicolas Graux &Trương Minh Quý, 2025)

1511549.title: Still Sexy
1511549.overview: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

1516925.title: You Have Her Eyes
1516925.overview: A woman's fears about having children begin to manifest as visions of her dead grandmother.

1530941.title: Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames
1530941.overview: Upon meeting a young boy named Haruta who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hiwa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Haruta's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

1532477.title: In-I In Motion
1532477.overview: In 2007, Juliette Binoche and Akram Khan took a break and co-created In-I, an original performance that toured the world. Today, Juliette Binoche revisits that exhilarating journey. Through unfamiliar images, she reflects on creation, its challenges, and the personal transformation it brings as a filmmaker.

1534205.title: Papaya
1534205.overview: Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

1555901.title: Fireworks Over Yonder
1555901.overview: When a young man named Henry wakes up from a coma on New Year's Eve 1999, he discovers that the world has changed drastically while he slept. People are no longer allowed to set foot on his city's beaches, and every night unnatural lights streak through the sky towards a destination unknown.

1564157.title: The Virus of Pathological Kindness
1564157.overview: On a cold winter's night in 1983, a young teacher of Serbo-Croatian recieves a surprise visit. A nude man, claiming to be from Belgrade in the far future tells her that the world as they know it will crumble and that he believes he knows how to stop it.

1564797.title: Love( ) Mave
1564797.overview: The journey of Mavis, a 23 year old writer based in New York, who's longing for love has had a turbulence lately; despite living the "happily ever after" with her long term boyfriend - Rehan. Being the gifted writer that she is, ironically she can't seem to find the words to express the sudden shift of feelings towards her partner. Tackling themes such as guilt, love, and falling out of it; Love ( ) Mave explores what it's like to be in love with someone with all your being, but just not the way as you had before and all the strings of intimacy in between.

1566589.title: No Other Love
1566589.overview: The Pandora's box opened in the name of love has already been unlocked. When love is consumed by obsession, just how many uncrossable boundaries will one break just to hold onto what they call "love"?
1566589.trailerName: 【电影《蜂蜜的针》预告】赵薇导演，李樯编剧、监制，袁梅制片，袁泉、耿乐领衔主演。

1568509.title: Mono No Aware
1568509.overview: In Japan's quiet apartments, a Filipino kodokushi cleaner meets an elderly widower who asks him for one final favor before he dies. What begins as a promise becomes a quiet story of grief, family, and accepting life's impermanence.
1568509.trailerName: Mono no Aware (CinePanalo 2026) Official Trailer - juan karlos, Perry Dizon, Momoko Kobayashi

1573757.title: The Latcher
1573757.overview: An overworked midwife, hollowed by an unspoken personal tragedy, is haunted by waking nightmares of an eerie presence that creeps from the shadowy bushland into the home where she lost everything.

1574909.title: Geisha War
1574909.overview: Rival bosses of Japanese Yakuza and American Mafia fight for control. Blood is shed... like fountains.

1590653.title: Maids to Order
1590653.overview: A driven entrepreneur establishes a domestic helper agency, navigating the complex and often humorous dynamics of managing her idiosyncratic staff while simultaneously resolving personal crises.

1590909.title: IBUKU
1590909.overview: A destitute widow and former traditional dancer defies social ostracization to embark on a desperate international journey, seeking a final reconciliation with her estranged daughter who faces execution abroad for the murder of an abusive employer.
1590909.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 마이 마더 IBUKU | 경쟁

1594301.title: A city beyond the harbor
1594301.overview: Tormented by a mysterious malaise, a woman tries to go on with her daily tasks. Meanwhile, her son becomes involved with another young man as all the spaces around them seem to point towards the end.

1598717.title: Fire, Water, Earth, Air
1598717.overview: Four stories from the Nordic region paint a picture of a changing natural world, where the elements rage and where being prepared proves to be much more than sandbags and fire extinguishers.

1603261.title: A Thing of the Past
1603261.overview: A pharmaceutical trial promises Aya her lost memories, but as they return, her body begins to manifest them in disturbing ways.

1604861.title: Winter Lights
1604861.overview: Experimental short movie shot during Christmas and New Year's Eve.

1608445.title: Tarung: Unforgiven
1608445.overview: After unintentionally causing the death of his opponent during a martial arts tournament, Hatta vows to never participate in any fighting tournament again. However, when his only sister becomes seriously ill and requires costly medical treatment, he is offered 'financial assistance' by a head of mobsters in return for Hatta fighting for him in the underworld fighting ring.

1612285.title: The Patron
1612285.overview: The cleaner moves like a nameless shadow on the fringes of cultural capital. When one of her employers — a wealthy art benefactor — leaves town, the door to another life suddenly opens, allowing her to step forward as someone more intriguing, someone whose name is met with admiration and respect. Two young art students are quick to be charmed by the power player she pretends to be, and together they embark on a tantalizing dance through the night, where the boundaries between art and exploitation blur and the truth waits just around the corner.

1613693.title: Otter
1613693.overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

1615229.title: Born In Blue
1615229.overview: Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine and set in Mount Gambier (Berrin), South Australia. The story follows Lumy, a young girl who grows up in New Zealand before moving with her father to the quiet volcanic town beside the Blue Lake. In the late 1800s, time traveling villains arrive from the future, drawn to a powerful phenomenon beneath the lake and seeking Lumy herself. At the lake’s edge, her father sacrifices his life to protect her, altering the course of time. Marked by trauma and a mysterious bond to the water, Lumy grows up driven by grief and unanswered questions, turning to science while unaware she is still being hunted. Years later, alongside fellow scientist Ashton, she uncovers the truth the same force beneath Berrin fuels both the villains’ technology and her own ability to move through time. Realising what she has inherited, Lumy prepares to fight back and protect what her father died to save.

1616189.title: Douglas Gordon by Douglas Gordon
1616189.overview: An intimate portrait of the Turner Prize-winning artist. As the boundary between reality and performance blurs, the shifting relationship between filmmaker and subject calls into question who is actually making the film.

1620477.title: Edie Arnold Is a Loser
1620477.overview: Timid dork Edie accidentally takes the spotlight when she starts a punk band with her fellow “turds”, becoming an icon to the rest of the losers at her all-girls Catholic school while managing to piss off the hot girls, the nuns, and the horniest altar boy you’ve ever seen.

1621693.title: The Untold Story of No Retreat No Surrender
1621693.overview: Exploring the story behind the 1980s cult classic, examining the mix of Hong Kong action with Western storytelling, how Kurt McKinney inspired kids and teenagers to fight back against bullies, how the world was introduced to Jean Claude Van Damme,  and how it impacted the VHS generation.

1625661.title: This Time, I Mean It
1625661.overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

1631485.title: Strangers in the Park
1631485.overview: A former communist militant and a "live and let live" man form an unlikely friendship on a park bench, sharing their life stories with humor and heart.

1634301.title: Vanaveera
1634301.overview: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.
1634301.trailerName: VANARA TEASER | Avinash Thiruveedhula | Simran Choudhary | Nandu | Vivek Sagar

1642685.overview: Documentary centers on how head coach Mark Few turned the small college program into a national powerhouse that became a regular contender in the NCAA Division I men’s basketball tournament known as March Madness.

1643197.title: Models vs. Werewolves
1643197.overview: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon...

1645245.title: Dreadful Mother
1645245.overview: Victoria awakens with a broken arm in a country house after being kidnapped. A doctor and nun care for her, but as she gradually uncovers their secrets, she realizes things aren't what they seem.

1656061.title: Immortal Combat

1659389.title: One Piece Heroines
1659389.overview: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

1662461.title: After We Are Born
1662461.overview: A New Psychological Documentary About Children

1666749.title: Duck Duck Goose

As they attempt to carry out the plan without drawing attention, tensions rise and their friendship is put under strain.

1672061.title: Our House
1672061.overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

1676477.title: How to Feed a Dictator
1676477.overview: Five private chefs to fearsome dictators all over the world share their experiences of the kitchens and circumstances that led them to these sometimes dangerous and often morally compromising workplaces.

1679101.title: Ethereal Torments
1679101.overview: In order to find balance between physical attractions, an obedient man stands before two deities.

1684989.title: Ghatak Was Here
1684989.overview: A personal essay film about the life, death and resurrection of the great Bengali director Ritwik Ghatak

1685309.title: 2026 TXT Moa Con in Japan: Live Viewing
1685309.overview: A special concert prepared exclusively for MOA to celebrate TOMORROW X TOGETHER's 7th  debut anniversary, [2026 TXT MOA CON]. Experience a powerful live band performance and special solos, showcasing each member’s unique talent.
1685309.trailerName: '2026 TXT MOA CON IN JAPAN: LIVE VIEWING' Official Trailer

1698557.title: The Goose That Laid the Golden Egg
1698557.overview: When a psychiatrist discovers that a medication for the treatment of acne is causing teenagers to kill themselves, the pharmaceutical company sets out on a campaign to destroy the source of the threat to their billion-dollar-a-year drug.

1699709.title: Three Stars
1699709.overview: Three star reviews are tricky. Some people think they're good and some think they're bad. So they really can go either way.

1701821.title: Sea Otters: A Wild Family Adventure
1701821.overview: Sea otter documentary filmed around Vancouver Island, British Colombia, Canada, following mom, Bella, and son, Finn as they learn to survive the winter together. Narrated by Joe Geoffrey.

1702525.title: The Boys of Dungeon Lane: In Conversation with Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal
1702525.overview: Premiering exclusively on Amazon Live and Amazon Music, this short film features an intimate conversation between Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal, exploring the memories, relationships, events and stories that inform McCartney’s forthcoming album of the same name.
1702525.trailerName: Paul McCartney – The Boys of Dungeon Lane (Official Album Trailer)

1702909.title: Ballad Of The Trumpet
1702909.overview: An inexperienced robber brings his obnoxious best friend along for his last job. But, as the night grows colder; dark secrets and horrific truths are revealed.

1703229.title: SAMA
1703229.overview: A Boy's Journey to understand music through Nature and discover his own self in the process.

1705213.title: Caught Between Lands
1705213.overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

1705789.title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
1705789.overview: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

1707389.title: What Happens After Murder
1707389.overview: At a birthday party, Sandra publicly exposes her boyfriend’s betrayals—then she is brutally murdered during a sudden blackout. The story then shifts into an intense whodunit. Trapped with her closest friends, paranoia erupts as secrets, affairs, hidden and deadly motives surface. As secrets unravel and trust collapses, they discover the murder was only the beginning. The real horror isn’t just who killed her, but what the murder reveals about them all.
1707389.trailerName: What happens after murder? (2026) Official trailer

1709565.title: No Survivors
1709565.overview: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, it follows a young man seeking revenge against the "White Tiger" bandits who destroyed his family.

1710781.title: The Troll
1710781.overview: A TikTok megastar spirals after one cruel comment, stalking her troll in a descent that blurs fame, obsession, and revenge.

1712445.title: Layover
1712445.overview: A stranded Marine awaiting a flight home forges an unexpected bond with a marginalized stranger during one tense night in 1966.

1713277.title: The King of Black Goo
1713277.overview: A bitter, lonely man undergoes a personality-altering medical procedure in the hope that it will make him worthy of love.

1713789.title: Reverse Myself
1713789.overview: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

1714173.title: Cucumber John

1715005.overview: During a seemingly ordinary school vacation, eight-year-old Diego struggles to understand why his older brother, Nicco, has suddenly become distant. While Diego clings to the simple rituals that once brought them together, Nicco retreats further into silence, carrying a pain no one around him fully sees. As memories of happier Julys blur with the present, Diego is forced to confront a reality beyond his understanding. Through the eyes of a child, JULY explores the quiet weight of depression, the bonds between siblings, and the small acts of love that can become lifelines in moments of darkness.

1715325.title: Roadkill
1715325.overview: An unknown man is on the loose, murdering people and leaving them on the side of the road. You must be careful when driving, or you could be next.

1715581.title: Lunacy
1715581.overview: Someone who has been engulfed by mental illness attempts to overthrow his twisted mind.

1715709.title: Comète
1715709.overview: As a comet streaks across the Paris sky, lives intersect in a mysterious dance. Two friends roam the city, taking stock of their lives. A young woman reconnects with a father she had long since given up on. Another sells drugs for her brother. Elsewhere, two souls haunted by death cross paths. Meanwhile, actors rehearse a play that strangely mirrors these lives. A portrait of unexpected encounters and the chance events that weave the fabric of our lives.

1716541.title: 我想留在你身边
1716541.overview: Ancient architecture restorer Jiang Nanshan falls for medical student Li Ai, only to discover that she comes from a parallel world where time flows in reverse and their timelines move in opposite directions.

1717245.title: Original Night
1717245.overview: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

1717693.title: Deuce Purgatory
1717693.overview: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

1718397.title: Ghabadkund
1718397.overview: Ghabadkund is the first Marathi cinematic universe-a gripping blend of suspense, action adventure. In a mysterious village, a string of unexplained events pulls an outsider into a hidden world of secrets tied to the legend of Ghabadkund

1718973.title: Sam Is Dead
1718973.overview: Two best friends Sam and James, until Sam is whacked by a rival gang opponent. Leaving James on a mission of vengeance.

1721341.title: Sonny Mango
1721341.overview: From Venus to Mars, through sun and earth. From Venus to Sonny Mango. That is the journey - or more specifically, the experience - that defines Anton, who describes, in the smoothest way possible, the state of mind that surrounds the powerless artist meeting his creator.

1722749.title: ESPECTRO
1722749.overview: As her mother's Alzheimer's progresses, Maria Rita struggles with the growing weight of becoming her sole caregiver.

1723069.title: Women Calling
1723069.overview: Morgane wakes up after a sexual assault to the sound of a female voice whispering her name. She tries to seek help and make her way home, but strange occurrences appear on her path. Apparitions of women clothed in identical red sheets, incomprehensible phone calls, and hands reaching out toward her disrupt her journey. Morgane loses control of her body and consciousness, forced to relive the night that sealed her fate. She becomes trapped in a nightmare from which she cannot escape. Her only way out might require for blood to be bled.

1726589.title: Cashcade
1726589.overview: A burglar on the run accidentally leaves a trail of cash that leads a homeless man into an unexpected discovery.

1727549.title: Haunted Carnival
1727549.overview: As the carnival turns into a death trap, the guests must survive challenges while carnival freaks hunt every single one of them.

1728125.title: I Have Laughed Again
1728125.overview: Lan, a stoic counselor, masks her soul's fractures with professional restraint until she meets Zhen-Zhen. The rebellious dropout's fragmented talk of a fatal car accident strikes a terrifying chord—it is the same tragedy that claimed Lan's lover. What begins as therapy spirals into a dangerous obsession.

1728189.title: Street of Dreams
1728189.overview: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

1728829.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
1728829.trailerName: Bhootu Aaya Bhago I Official Teaser

1729149.title: Rumours of Madam Roach
1729149.overview: A woman is monitoring her neighbours through a pair of world altering binoculars, while the world around her deteriorates.
1729149.trailerName: Rumours of Madam Roach (2026) Official Trailer | Experimental Horror

1729405.title: No Name, No Address
1729405.overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

1731133.title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet
1731133.overview: Based off the Wattpad Series by PRNCSPLM the third book in the series following The Both Sides Of Me. The last and final year of Junior High in 10 Sapphire everything changes when Chase's Ex Mackzyn transfers in his school and his section.

1732605.title: Sannidhanam P.O.
1732605.overview: A mother's search for her son who went missing when he was a child.
1732605.trailerName: Sannidhanam P.O - Trailer | Yogi Babu, Pramod Shetty, Roopesh Shetty | AGR | Amutha Sarathy

1735997.title: Ground Floor
1735997.overview: Follows Kristóf, a man who discovers black mould covering his apartment wall and begins questioning neighbors about leaky pipes, triggering events that turn his world upside down.

1736125.title: The Girls Garden
1736125.overview: Julia inherited her mother Asunta’s job as a domestic worker in the wealthy De la Puente household, where she was raised alongside the family’s daughters. Asunta, an Andean woman who migrated to Lima after Peru’s 1970 earthquake, carried a life shaped by displacement, silence, and sacrifice. Over the years, affection and inequality became inseparably intertwined within the household. Now, as illness and old age expose long-buried secrets, Julia is forced to confront the invisible social order that has defined her existence. Torn between loyalty and freedom, she must decide whether to remain in the role imposed on her or finally reclaim her own identity.

1738365.title: Rienzi: Bayreuth Festival 2026
1738365.overview: Opening the 2026 Bayreuth Festival in its 150th anniversary year, this live stream presents Wagner’s Rienzi, his early grand opera and once his greatest success, in the Festspielhaus for the first time. The staging is entrusted to award-winning directors Alexandra Szemerédy and Magdolna Parditka, while Nathalie Stutzmann conducts a superb cast led by Heldentenor Andreas Schager in the title role, with Gabriela Scherer as Irene and Jennifer Holloway as Adriano. With its massed choruses, public spectacle and private tragedy, Rienzi promises to open this landmark Bayreuth Festival in unmissable style.

1738813.title: Perduta gente
1738813.overview: At his first illegal rave, nineteen-year-old Valerio follows two older friends into a night of excess and abandon. As the night unravels, his longing for approval draws him into a darkness he can no longer escape.

1739197.title: Сказка
1739197.overview: 70-year-old Larisa and 65-year-old Oleg are lonely members of an amateur "Theater of Honor" for the elderly, where neither is taken seriously. Larisa is denied roles and is made fun of, while Oleg also remains invisible to those around her. At some point, they notice each other, and a romantic connection develops between them, which may be their last attempt to escape their loneliness and feel needed.

1739517.title: Blind Road
1739517.overview: Completed in 2019, this short film remained unreleased for years before finally premiering at various film festivals in 2025, where it screened to critical acclaim and won multiple awards. In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.

1740925.title: Почтальон победы
1740925.overview: Great Patriotic War. 18-year-old field postman Azamat delivers valuable cargo to the front line every day. He knows all the secret paths in the forest and in the swamp, dreams of the feat and love of the field doctor Masha. When a military plane on a secret mission crashes in the forests, Azamat alone knows how to get to the target the fastest and sneak a reconnaissance group there unnoticed.

1742717.title: Limbo
1742717.overview: After my father’s death, I visit his house one last time. It is about to be demolished. I walk through it, searching the debris for traces of his memory. I find a few forgotten objects in the empty rooms. I am alone, and there is an echo. I speak aloud to silence the ghosts—or the absence. Finally, I come across a shared memory.

1743677.title: Rapinoe
1743677.overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

1744317.title: The Spectacular Death of Prisca
1744317.overview: On her daughter’s wedding day, a mother finds herself catapulted into a fever-dream quest to rescue her daughter.
1744317.trailerName: THE SPECTACULAR DEATH OF PRISCA Trailer | TIFF 2026

1745085.title: Жизнь после смерти
1745085.overview: This funny and tragic film explores the struggle to cope with the death of someone close to you. The main character, Tolya, who has just entered university, is confronted with the death of his mother from cancer and unexpectedly shoulders the responsibility of organizing the funeral: obtaining a death certificate, choosing a coffin and cemetery plot, calling relatives, and meeting his long-lost father. Irony becomes Tolya's only way to cope, so the characters and the world around them transform into grotesque versions of themselves: a nurse-bartender, a sinister cross seller, and an army of ninjas. But behind every humorous detail lies genuine pain.

1745725.title: Little Hollywood, Tennessee
1745725.overview: Each summer, twenty-four high school students across Tennessee are selected for one shot at creating a full-blown narrative motion picture. For one month, they live like college students, make difficult creative choices, and find out what they're made of when surrounded by skilled peers. On the precipice of the rest of their lives, these students navigate disagreement, impostor syndrome, and self-worth in this coming-of-age film that's a must-see for anyone with the creative urge.

1746749.title: Play Date
1746749.overview: A couple shows up for a dinner party, and slowly realize it's not that kind of party.

1753405.title: Pentimento
1753405.overview: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

1756413.title: Sisters
1756413.overview: Twelve-year-old Despina takes her younger sister, Annie, on a journey from the suburbs to the chaotic center of Athens, without explaining why or revealing their final destination.

1758141.title: Rough sea
1758141.overview: Daniela struggles with the traumas of a troubled past, while Massimo conceals unspeakable secrets behind his talent as a pianist, which has earned him the nickname Golden Hands. Their chance meeting at Pachanga on a Lazio beach in winter will change the direction of their lives. Their stolen glances, awkward silences, and attraction to one another will spark a relationship that rekindles hope that they can turn their lives around. While they take refuge in each other, however, the ghosts from the past are waiting to pounce. And when they do, nothing will go the way they expected. An existential noir about guilt and innocence, fate, and a desperate will to live.

1764157.title: Šipkaři
1764157.overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.
1764157.trailerName: ŠIPKAŘI (2026) HD teaser trailer CZ dabing

1764221.title: LOUTROPOLIS
1764221.overview: When the urban regeneration project of the former Ellinikon International Airport of Athens begins right outside his door, Vasos, one of the area’s oldest residents, struggles to adjust to a place that no longer feels like home.
